page.layout: One page of text. Top: page number at upper right. Below it a decorative woodcut band (two rows of ornaments, no text). Then a full-width italic title block in several lines, centred. Below: one column of body text with a large initial N at left. Signature "Q 2" at the foot left, catchword "jam" at the foot right.

main_text.head: Clarissimo & Reverendo Viro D. Carolo Rupiforti F. V. D. Verbi Dei Ministro, Olim in Insulis Americæ: Nunc verò Ecclesiæ Gallo-Belgicæ quæ Roterodami colligitur, Pastori, S.
main_text.p: NOlim, in limine, Vir, multis nominibus mihi observandé quemquam, Te arcessere crimine æquioris animi & Pietatis in sententiam meam de Potestate Ecclesiastica, quia hæc Epistola appareret in tuo nomine: Nam id à me fieri, Te non opinante, imo haud dubium reluctante confiteor Tibi: ut jam

page.notes: The large initial N is joined to "Olim". The title block is set in italic type with long s rendered as s. Some words in the body are damaged by print and staining ("observandé" and "dubium" were read with some uncertainty; "Olim" in the first line is a printed word). The first body line "NOlim" should read as the initial N followed by "Olim". Decorative woodcut band contains no text.
